anti_drift_rules: Every product slice must read CEW_PROJECT_STATE_CURRENT before implementation.
Every merged slice must update CEW_PROJECT_STATE_CURRENT in the same PR or an immediately linked state-update PR.
There is exactly one current work item; parallel technical tasks are children of it, not competing current states.
Historical architecture/research documents are immutable versioned references; CURRENT state is never reconstructed from conversation memory.
A residual is closed only by evidence, explicit authorized modeling rule, or documented engineering decision with receipt.
No UI state may become canonical engineering authority.
Confirmed documentary gaps must not trigger cyclic blind rereading without a new evidence hypothesis.
Evidence-link candidates are never counted as approved EvidenceSnippet objects.
Issue-level routing must preserve mixed residual-level states and must not flatten closed-search, review-target, conflict or measurement-required subroutes into a single generic action.
Machine visual review findings may populate the human review queue but cannot promote canonical reinforcement values or create single-member bindings by themselves.
Native human-review runtime receipts are audit inputs only; UI submit may create governed patch candidates but never canonical writes.
The user-facing production runtime must fail closed when authentication or persistent append-only audit storage is not configured; ephemeral production receipt storage is forbidden.
